description: A marine-waste monitoring capstone web application designed to track, visualize, and analyze marine waste data.

coreFeatures.description: Provides data visualization and key performance indicators (KPIs) for marine waste monitoring.
Geospatial visualization of marine waste data and hotspots.
components: Layer Panel (for managing different data layers)
Map Point Detail (for displaying details of specific waste locations)

coreFeatures.description: Informational page introducing the project, its methodology, and live statistics.

targetAudience: Environmental researchers, local authorities, and the general public interested in tracking and reducing marine waste.
